Set the path to GRASS add-ons directory

Source: R/startup-environment.R
set_addons_path.Rd

Set the path to GRASS add-ons directory

Usage

set_addons_path(addon_base = NULL, gv)

Arguments

addon_base

path to the GRASS addons directory

Value

The configured add-on path invisibly, or NULL if the directory does not exist.
